title: RAPID - RNA Analysis Pipeline for Integrated Diagnostics
author: Kylie Montgomery

steps.title: Primer Design and Target Selection
steps.instruction: Design primers based on the MANE Select transcript to capture the full length of the gene of interest, targeting an amplicon size of 1–3 kb (up to 8 kb if necessary).

substeps.instruction: Verify gene expression in relevant tissue (e.g., whole blood) using GTEx (≥1 TPM) and Human Protein Atlas.
Use NCBI Primer-BLAST with human genome (GRCh38) to design primers in exonic sequences, ensuring a minimum of 20 bp of exonic sequence at the 3' end.
Avoid splice sites, polymorphic sites (dbSNP), high GC content (>70%), or repetitive elements.
For genes >6 kb, design two or more overlapping amplicons with a minimum overlap of 200 bp.
Verify predicted amplicon size and structure using the UCSC genome browser in-silico PCR tool.

steps.title: RNA Extraction from Cell Culture
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from cell-culture monolayers using RNeasy columns.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate cell-culture medium and rinse cells with 700 µl of 1x PBS; aspirate again.
Add 350 µl Buffer RLT to the dish, collect lysate with a rubber policeman, and vortex for 1 min.
Add 350 µl of 70% ethanol to the lysate and mix by pipetting.
Transfer up to 700 µl of sample to an RNeasy spin column and centrifuge for 30 s at ≥8000g.
Add 10 µl DNase I stock to 70 µl Buffer RDD, mix by inverting, and apply 80 µl of this mix directly to the column membrane; incubate at 20–30°C for 15 min.
Wash column with 350 µl Buffer RW1 (30 s at ≥8000g), then 500 µl Buffer RPE (30 s at ≥8000g), and a final 500 µl Buffer RPE (2 min at ≥8000g).
Transfer column to a new 2 ml collection tube and centrifuge at full speed for 1 min.
Elute RNA by adding 30 µl RNAse-free water to the membrane and centrifuging for 1 min at ≥8000g (repeat elution if higher concentration is needed).
Transfer 6 µl of sample for Nanodrop/Qubit QC.

steps.title: RNA Extraction from PAXgene Blood Tubes
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from PAXgene Blood RNA Tubes (BRT).

substeps.instruction: Incubate BRT for at least 2 h at room temperature (or overnight) after collection.
Centrifuge BRT for 10 min at 3000–5000 x g using a swing-bucket rotor.
Remove supernatant, add 4 mL RNase-Free Water (RNFW), vortex until dissolved, and centrifuge for 10 min at 3000–5000 x g; discard supernatant.
Add 350 µL resuspension buffer (BR1) and vortex until dissolved.
Transfer to 1.5 mL MCT, add 300 µL binding buffer (BR2) and 40 µL proteinase K (PK), vortex for 5 s, and incubate for 10 min at 55°C in a shaker-incubator (400–1400 rpm).
Transfer lysate to a PSC (lilac) in a 2 mL PT and centrifuge for 3 min at max speed (≤20,000 x g).
Transfer supernatant to a fresh 1.5 mL MCT, add 350 µL ethanol (96–100%), vortex, and centrifuge briefly (1–2 s at 500–1000 x g).
Pipette 700 µL sample into a PRC (red) in a 2 mL PT and centrifuge for 1 min at 8000–20,000 x g; repeat for remaining sample.
Wash PRC with 350 µL wash buffer 1 (BR3) for 1 min at 8000–20,000 x g.
Prepare DNase I mix (10 µL DNase I stock in 70 µL RDD), apply 80 µL directly to PRC membrane, and incubate at 20–30°C for 15 min.
Wash PRC with 350 µL BR3 (1 min at 8000–20,000 x g), then 500 µL BR4 (1 min at 8000–20,000 x g), and a final 500 µL BR4 (3 min at 8000–20,000 x g).
Centrifuge for 1 min at 8000–20,000 x g to dry the membrane.
Elute RNA by adding 40 µL elution buffer (BR5) to the PRC and centrifuging for 1 min at 8000–20,000 x g; repeat elution with 40 µL BR5.
Incubate eluate for 5 min at 65°C in shaker-incubator (no shaking), then chill on ice.
Transfer 6 µl of sample for Nanodrop/Qubit QC.

steps.title: cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Perform reverse transcription to generate cDNA from 2 pg–200 ng of poly(A) total RNA (RIN ≥ 8.0).

substeps.instruction: Prepare annealing mix on ice: Up to 8 µl total RNA (≥5 ng), 1 µl (or 2 µl) NEBNext Single Cell RT Primer Mix, and Nuclease-free Water to 9 µl total.
Incubate for 5 min at 70°C (lid 105°C), then hold at 4°C.
Prepare RT mix on ice: 5 µl NEBNext Single Cell RT Buffer, 1 µl NEBNext Template Switching Oligo, 2 µl NEBNext Single Cell RT Enzyme Mix, and 3 µl Nuclease-free Water (11 µl total).
Combine 11 µl RT mix with 9 µl annealed sample, mix, and centrifuge.
Incubate in thermal cycler (lid 105°C): 90 min at 42°C, 10 min at 70°C, then hold at 4°C.

steps.title: cDNA Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the cDNA using a high-fidelity PCR process.

substeps.instruction: Prepare amplification mix: 50 µl NEBNext Single Cell cDNA PCR Master Mix, 2 µl NEBNext Single Cell cDNA PCR Primer, 0.5 µl NEBNext Cell Lysis Buffer, and 27.5 µl Nuclease-free Water (80 µl total).
Add 80 µl mix to 20 µl of sample and mix.

Run PCR (lid 105°C): 98°C for 45 s (1 cycle); then [98°C for 10 s, 62°C for 15 s, 72°C for 3 min] for 7–21 cycles based on RNA input (e.g., 2 pg: 20-21 cycles; 100 ng: 7-8 cycles); final extension 72°C for 5 min; hold at 4°C.

steps.title: cDNA Purification and Cleanup
steps.instruction: Purify the PCR product using SPRI beads and a two-step cleanup process.

substeps.instruction: Incubate samples at room temperature for 5 min.
Add 60 µl (0.6X) resuspended SPRI beads to the reaction, mix, and separate on a magnetic stand for 5 min; discard supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 200 µl 80% ethanol (30 s incubation each); air dry for 2–5 min.
Elute cDNA with 50 µl 0.1X TE, incubate for 2 min at room temperature.
Perform second cleanup: Add 45 µl NEBNext Bead Reconstitution Buffer, incubate 5 min at room temperature, separate on magnet for 5 min, and discard supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 200 µl 80% ethanol; air dry for 2–5 min.
Elute cDNA with 33 µl 1X TE (or 10 mM Tris pH 8.0), incubate for 2 min at room temperature, and transfer 30 µl to a new PCR tube.

steps.title: Target Amplicon Generation
steps.instruction: Perform targeted PCR to amplify the specific gene region.

substeps.instruction: Prepare master mix: 2x VeriFi Hot Start Mix (12.5/25 µl), Forward Primer 10 µM (1/2 µl), Reverse Primer 10 µM (1/2 µl), DMSO (1/2 µl), Template cDNA (up to 100/200 ng), and dH2O to final volume (25/50 µl).
Run PCR: 95°C for 1 min; then [95°C for 15 s, 62°C for 15 s, 72°C for 10-30 s/kb] for 25-35 cycles; final hold at 4°C.

steps.title: End-Prep and Bead Cleanup
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA ends for ligation and purify.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 200 fmol (130 ng for 1 kb) of DNA per sample into 0.2 ml tubes, make up to 11.5 µl with Nuclease-free water.
Add 1 µl Diluted DNA Control Sample (DCS), 1.75 µl Ultra II End-prep Reaction Buffer, and 0.75 µl Ultra II End-prep Enzyme Mix.
Incubate at 20°C for 5 min and 65°C for 5 min.
Clean up: Add 15 µl AMPure XP beads, incubate on Hula mixer for 5 min, pellet on magnet, and wash twice with 200 µl 80% ethanol.
Air dry for 30 s, resuspend in 10 µl Nuclease-free water, incubate for 2 min, pellet on magnet, and retain 10 µl eluate.

steps.title: Native Barcode Ligation
steps.instruction: Ligate unique barcodes to the end-prepped cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Combine 7.5 µl end-prepped cDNA, 2.5 µl Native Barcode (NB01-24), and 10 µl Blunt/TA Ligase Master Mix.
Incubate for 20 min at RT.
Add EDTA (2 µl for clear cap, 4 µl for blue cap) and pool all barcoded samples into a 1.5 ml DNA LoBind tube.
Clean up: Add 0.4X AMPure XP beads, incubate on Hula mixer for 10 min, pellet on magnet, and wash twice with 700 µl 80% ethanol.
Air dry for 30 s, resuspend in 35 µl Nuclease-free water, and incubate for 10 min at 37°C (agitate every 2 min for 10 s).
Pellet on magnet and retain 35 µl eluate.

steps.title: Adapter Ligation and Final Cleanup
steps.instruction: Ligate adapters and perform final size-selection cleanup.

substeps.instruction: Combine 30 µl pooled barcoded sample, 5 µl Native Adapter (NA), 10 µl NEBNext Quick Ligation Reaction Buffer (5X), and 5 µl Quick T4 DNA Ligase.
Incubate for 20 min at RT.
Clean up: Add 20 µl AMPure XP beads, incubate on Hula mixer for 10 min, and pellet on magnet.
Wash beads with 125 µl Long Fragment Buffer (LFB) for >3 kb enrichment or Short Fragment Buffer (SFB) for all sizes; repeat wash.
Resuspend pellet in 15 µl Elution Buffer (EB), incubate for 10 min at 37°C (agitate every 2 min for 10 s), and pellet on magnet for 1 min.
Retain 15 µl eluate, quantify 1 µl via Qubit, and make up library to 12 µl at 10-20 fmol.

steps.title: Flow Cell Priming and Library Loading
steps.instruction: Prime the Nanopore flow cell and load the prepared library.

substeps.instruction: Prepare priming mix: 1,170 µl Flow Cell Flush (FCF), 5 µl BSA (50 mg/ml), and 30 µl Flow Cell Tether (FCT).
Open priming port, remove air bubbles using a P1000 pipette (draw back 20-30 µl), and load 800 µl priming mix; wait 5 min.
Prepare loading mix: 37.5 µl Sequencing Buffer (SB), 25.5 µl Library Beads (LIB), and 12 µl cDNA library.
Complete priming: Load 200 µl priming mix into the priming port.
Load 75 µl of the prepared library into the SpotON sample port dropwise.

steps.title: Sequencing Run
steps.instruction: Configure and start the sequencing run on MinION or GridION.

substeps.instruction: Perform flow cell check and select 'DNA', multiplexing 'Yes', and kit 'SQK-NBD114-24'.
Set run length: 72 hours for up to 10 samples, or 4-12 hours for a single sample and pooled control.
Use high accuracy basecaller and output demultiplexed fastq files for the RAPID pipeline.
